exam_pattern.details: The written examination consists of multiple-choice questions (MCQs) in English only, carrying 1 mark per question with no negative marking. Duration is 80 minutes.

syllabus.details: General Knowledge & Reasoning: Current affairs (national/international), awareness of events, Indian history, Indian freedom movement, art & culture, geography, economics, general polity and constitution, awards and honors, sports, gender and weaker sections sensitivity, environmental issues, common abbreviations, current technological developments, Ladakh history, art, culture, geography, and current affairs. Reasoning topics include analogies, similarities and differences, spatial visualization, problem solving, analysis, judgment, decision making, visual memory, coding-decoding, non-verbal series, number series, alphabet series, and number ranking. General Science: Basic principles of General Science and Life Science (up to 10th Class for subordinate posts; graduation level for Assistant Superintendent Jail). English Comprehension (Assistant Superintendent Jail only): Understanding correct English, vocabulary, grammar, sentence structure, synonyms, antonyms, spelling/spot the error, fill in the blanks, idioms & phrases, one word substitution, sentence improvement, active/passive voice, direct/indirect narration, sentence rearrangement, and comprehension passages. Arithmetic Abilities: Number system, simple interest, average, ratio and proportion, percentage, profit and loss, time and work, work and wages, time and distance, clocks and calendars, mensuration, problems on LCM and HCF, simple equations, square roots, bar & graphs, and data interpretation.

how_to_apply: Visit the official Ladakh Police recruitment portal at police.ladakh.gov.in.
Navigate to the online application link activated for advertisement number 03 of 2026.
Register using your mobile number and fill out the online application form with personal and educational details.
Upload a scanned colour passport-size photograph in JPG format (up to 500 KB) in white background, taken within the last three months.
Pay the prescribed application fee online via Net Banking, Debit/Credit Card, or UPI.
Review all entered details carefully before final submission, as category and date of birth cannot be edited later.
Submit the form and take a printout/PDF copy of the submitted application form for future reference.
important_instructions: Candidates must possess eligibility as on the last date of application submission. Applications without the prescribed fee will be summarily rejected. In-service candidates must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their Head of Department. Candidates appearing for PST/PET must bring two recent passport-size photographs and a valid original photo ID proof (Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, Driving License, PAN Card, Passport, etc.). Only one application per candidate is permitted; duplicate applications will lead to summary rejection. Biometric data, CCTV footage, and RFID timing will be used during the recruitment stages to ensure transparency.

content_sections.heading: LPSSRB Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Register for Job Alerts ↗ Official Website & Apply Online The Ladakh Police Subordinate Service Recruitment Board (LPSSRB) has announced 12 vacancies in the Ladakh Prison Department. Eligible candidates with a valid Ladakh UT Domicile Certificate can apply online from 16 October to 8 November 2026. Selection includes the Physical Measurement Test (PMT), Physical Endurance Test (PET), document verification and written examination. Admit cards are scheduled to be available from 14 November 2026. ↓ Download Official Notification PDF

rows.qualification_required: Post Graduate Degree in Social Work, Sociology, Psychology, or Criminology acquired on or before the cut-off date.
Passed 10th Class/matriculation from a recognised Board of School Education by or before the cut-off date.

Graduation from a recognized university in any stream with one year Diploma in Computer Software applications; OR B.Sc. IT/BCA; OR Three years Diploma in Computer Applications/Software Application from an AICTE recognized institute.
Graduation degree from any recognized University AND 200 hours or six months certificate course in Computer Applications from recognized institute.
Passed 10th class/matriculation from a recognised Board of School Education by or before the cut-off date.

Passed 10th class/matriculation from a recognised Board of School Education AND minimum 3-month certificate course in the trade of Barber from any Institute accredited by National Skill Development Corporation (N.S.D.C.).

faq.question: Q1. How many total vacancies are announced under LPSSRB Advertisement No. 03 of 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 12 vacancies are notified across various posts including Assistant Superintendent Jail, Warder, Computer Assistant, Junior Assistant, Orderly, and Barber.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply online for LPSSRB recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of online application forms is 08.11.2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for LPSSRB posts?
faq.answer: The age limit for all posts is 18 to 28 years reckoned as on 01.01.2026, with admissible relaxations for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q4. What are the essential qualifications for Assistant Superintendent Jail?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate Degree in Social Work, Sociology, Psychology, or Criminology.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for LPSSRB recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, application fees range from ₹400 to ₹700 depending on the specific post and candidate category, payable online.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection stages include a Physical Measurement Test (PMT), Physical Endurance Test (PET), document scrutiny, typing/driving test where applicable, and a written examination.

faq.question: Q7. When will the PST/PET process commence?
faq.answer: The PST/PET process will commence from 20.11.2026 onwards.

faq.question: Q8. What is the required age relaxation for SC, ST, and ALC candidates?
faq.answer: SC, ST, and ALC candidates are eligible for a permissible relaxation of 5 years in the upper age limit.
